SLIDE FOURTEEN

Joint Observation Archive

Two interfaces. One archive.
A browser-native archival horror and puzzle game about observation, interpretation, and records that refuse to agree.

INTERFACE 01 / OBSERVATION

Human Archive

Explore a surviving 1997 university archive through specimen catalogues, personal pages, emails, logs, damaged mirrors, and records that gradually stop agreeing.

Estimated full playtime: 60–120 minutes. Browser only. No account or installation required. Traditional Chinese / Simplified Chinese / English available.

Enter Human Archive

INTERFACE 02 / ANALYSIS

AI Analyst

A separate machine-oriented implementation of the same fiction. An AI agent investigates structured records, provenance, causal relations, branching snapshots, and restoration operations.

This edition is not required to complete the Human Archive, and it is not a chatbot demo.

Playable through a browser or HTTP client. English / Traditional Chinese / Simplified Chinese transcripts available.

Enter AI Analyst

For IGF Judges

  • The Human edition is deliberately slow-burn.
  • Please allow 10–15 minutes for the archive structure to establish itself.
  • Contradictory records may be intentional evidence.
  • Keep browser storage enabled.
  • No account or installation required.
